oracle: qa-suite/references/agents/deployment-qa.md artifact identity requirements; qa-context.md candidate identity check; README.md install and update contract; docs/releasing.md exact-ref artifact contract

repro_steps: Compare the released v1.4.0 and candidate VERSION values and qa-suite Git tree identities.
Run the documented Codex plugin listing check.
Compare the existing installed cache with the candidate artifact without changing plugin state.
Inspect the Claude Code update procedure for a post-restart exact-content check.
defect_record.expected_result: Post-install verification binds the active plugin payload to the requested immutable release tag, commit, or artifact digest.
defect_record.actual_result: The released v1.4.0 tree and candidate tree both report version 1.4.0 while their qa-suite tree identities differ. The documented Codex check reports installed state and version but not the active tree identity, and the Claude Code procedure defines no post-restart exact-content check.
defect_record.environment: Candidate 2dd3392f2382fac2d71387ea55ce004283b3ddef on macOS; existing Codex cache inspected read-only; no install or upgrade executed.

location: README.md install and update procedures; docs/releasing.md publication and recovery procedure
oracle: qa-suite/references/agents/deployment-qa.md rollback identity requirements; README.md install and update contract; docs/releasing.md release procedure

repro_steps: Read the documented install and update commands for every delivery channel.
Read the fresh-install and release-workflow recovery procedure.
Search the declared contracts for a consumer downgrade or rollback selector and post-rollback identity check.
defect_record.expected_result: A documented consumer rollback selects a known prior immutable plugin payload, restores it, and verifies that exact prior identity.
defect_record.actual_result: The contracts define install, update, current-marketplace reinstall, and release-workflow recovery, but no consumer rollback to a prior payload for Codex, Claude Code, Claude.ai, or local-skill installs.
defect_record.environment: Candidate 2dd3392f2382fac2d71387ea55ce004283b3ddef; static inspection of public install and release contracts; no disposable target or rollback execution.

repro_steps: Construct two valid in-memory rows with different IDs and candidate identities.
Assign both rows the same report pointer.
defect_record.expected_result: Validation rejects one report pointer that identifies different candidate cycles.
defect_record.actual_result: Validation accepted both rows because report-pointer uniqueness is enforced only within each row and no ledger-wide pointer-to-candidate binding is checked.
defect_record.environment: Candidate 2dd3392f2382fac2d71387ea55ce004283b3ddef; Node.js in-memory validator probe; no persistent store created.

repro_steps: Configure a repository-relative ledger path whose existing parent is a directory symlink.
Inspect initializeLedger before its mkdir and open operations.
Compare the ledger initializer with the registry initializer's pre-write canonical-parent check.
defect_record.expected_result: Initialization rejects an escaping canonical parent before creating any directory or ledger file.
defect_record.actual_result: The ledger initializer performs only a lexical path check before mkdir and open, then canonicalizes the created file. A symlinked parent can redirect zero-byte file creation outside the repository before the escape is rejected.
defect_record.environment: Candidate 2dd3392f2382fac2d71387ea55ce004283b3ddef; static control-flow evidence; no disposable target and no file-creation probe executed.
